edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] within [NUMBER OF DAYS TO BE AGREED] days after the effective date of this Agreement, by wire transfer pursuant to instructions separately provided and verified. The settlement amount and payment deadline remain open and are not agreed.
2. RELEASE. Only upon Plaintiff's receipt in cleared funds of the full settlement amount required under Section 1 shall Plaintiff release all claims against Defendant.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement shall remain confidential, except that either party may disclose them as required by law or to its legal and tax advisers. A party disclosing terms to its advisers shall inform them of their confidential nature and instruct them to maintain confidentiality, subject to disclosures required by law.

The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD [SETTLEMENT AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] within [NUMBER] days after the effective date of this Agreement, by wire transfer pursuant to instructions separately provided and verified. 2. RELEASE. Upon payment, Plaintiff releases all claims against Defendant. 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The terms of this settlement are strictly confidential. 4. NO ADMISSION. This settlement is not an admission of liability.
